title: Shareek-e-karbala
body:
Shareek-e-karbala
<<MINI>>
Shareeke karbala behan
Meri musafira behan
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ya Hussain) x4
Rasan mein bandh chukka gala lo chal para who kafila, behan ghareeb nawha gar, sina pe jab parhi nazar, khamosh the shaheed sab, akhi ke hilrahe the lab, (sina pe ho to kya huwa) x2
tu hosla na haarna, (behan mein saath saath hun) x3
<<MINI>>
Ghareebe karbala behan
Diler e ba wafa behan
Ghamon ki alqama behan
Meri musafira behan
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Wafae waada hochuka
Sina talaq mein aagaya
Mein apna kaam karchuka
Meri shareeke karbala
<<MINI>>
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye rassiyan ye beriyan
Qadam qadam be sakhtiyan
Rida bagher bibiyaan
Behan kara he imtehaan
<<MINI>>
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Agar he rasta kathan
Zara na dar meri behan
Tu berida mein bekafan
He waqt hosla shikan
<<MINI>>
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Qadam qadam shahadatein
Guzar gayi qayamatein
Abhi he aur afatein
Sambhale ab amaanatein
<<MINI>>
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi bhi ab nahin bacha
Bas abide shakista pa
Ye saare bane ghamzada
Gire jo khake ghash zara
<<MINI>>
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Behan teher teher yahi
Laraz rahi he kyun zameen
Sakina girgay kahin
Na milsake jo who hazeen
<<MINI>>
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Bohot qareeb shaam he
Hujoome khaaso aam he
Yazeede bad kalaam he
Ye waqte inteqaam he
<<MINI>>
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
Ghareebe karbala behan
Diler e ba wafa behan
Ghamon ki alqama behan
Meri musafira behan
Tu hosla na haarna
Sina pe hun to kya huwa
Tu hosla na haarna
(Behan mein saath saath hun) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
"Rehaan-o-sarware" aza
Jo sham pohoncha kafila
Sare hussain ne kaha
Ulat de takht shaam ka
<<MINI>>
